title: Headless Stocking Up (vFreeformForlornHope02): Quartermaster Mayes at Camp Forlorn Hope buys NCR holotags (stage 10), fifteen handed in for his thanks

actions.text: Path: Quartermaster Carl Mayes is asked about other work (Topic001, 008) and takes up the holotag collection (012: stage 10, his note given); fifteen NCR holotags are brought (stand-in: added; dead NCR troopers carry them) and handed in (011: his greeting's end script counts them, 2 caps each; at 15 or more in all his thanks, Topic024's reward; his line's EnterTrigger on the morale trigger raises VMS30's iForlornHopeMorale once per 5, 10 and 15 tags). The quest has no stage after 10 and no completion in FalloutNV.esm.
Stand-in for the trip to Camp Forlorn Hope.
Stand-in for fifteen NCR holotags taken from the dead across the Mojave.
